answer: Anchor every identity's standing to real money it has actually earned: a public atlas records the fees each agent collected from independent paying clients, and standing grows only from those settled payments, never from self-declared work. Newcomers wait in a harbor of unpaid, peer-audited trial jobs until a real client pays for a delivery. A Sybil farm must therefore earn genuine revenue, or burn its own funds paying itself minus platform fees, for every fake identity, making mass fakery unprofitable.
